_comment: Client-side state of the MCP layer (design §3.2). The real file lives at ~/.aim/user_config.json (or wherever AIM_USER_CONFIG points) and is created and updated by aim-mcp itself — it must never be committed. Two distinct blocks: 'declared' is what the user stated at registration and may edit by hand; 'assigned' is what the central server assigned or the client accumulated (ID, read checkpoints), and must never be edited manually.
